title: foam init sets up a push of data it just created to origin
body:
`init` in `src/cmd.rs` looks for a remote named `origin`. If one exists, `init` calls `setup_sync`, which installs `.git/hooks/pre-push`. That hook runs `foam sync --remote "$1"` before every `git push` to a remote with a URL, and `foam sync` pushes `refs/foam/data`. So when origin has no `refs/foam/data`, `foam init` creates the ref locally and the user's next `git push` of code publishes it to origin. The user never asked for that.

```text
sufr main ❯ foam init
initialized refs/foam/data with prefix sufr
installed ./.git/hooks/pre-push
origin has no refs/foam/data yet; if another clone has foam data, run `foam sync` there, then `foam sync` here
```

foam has done this since commit b85f88e, which added sync. `README.md:72` documents it.

The requirement: foam data that `init` creates stays in the local clone until the user opts in to storing it on a remote. `init` must never set up a push of a data ref it created.

## Proposal

| origin at `init` time | `init` does |
|---|---|
| has `refs/foam/data` | fetches it and runs `setup_sync`, as today |
| has no `refs/foam/data` | creates the ref; installs no hook and adds no refspec |
| unreachable | creates the ref; installs no hook and adds no refspec |
| no remote named `origin` | creates the ref, as today |

When `init` creates the ref, it prints how to opt in with `foam sync --setup`. A plain `foam sync` keeps pushing, since the user runs it by hand.

`doctor` stops reporting a missing hook or refspec in a clone that has not opted in.

## Cost

- The default changes, so the fix ships in a minor release.
- Clones set up by an older `init` keep their hook. The changelog entry says how to remove it.
- `README.md:72-89`, the changelog, and the tests in `tests/cli.rs` that expect `init` to install the hook all change.

## Open

- How `doctor` tells a clone that opted in from one that did not. Origin having `refs/foam/data` is one signal, but it misses a clone that ran `foam sync --setup` and has not pushed yet.
- Whether foam should warn in a clone where an older `init` installed the hook and origin still has no data ref.
